fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a silver motorcycle bearing registration number TN-01-ZZ-1047 was found missing from the parking space near Sevvanthi Colony Bus Stand Area in Vellore. The matter was brought to Vellore Town PS on 2026-04-19, while the incident was placed on 2026-04-19 at about 21:05. Amudha Sri reported the matter orally at Vellore Town PS; the contact number given was 9000000218. A person named Yuvaraj Natarajan, associated with the number 9000000298, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00389, as the mobile number 9000000298 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle reportedly taken during the night from a residential parking spot.
fields.Keywords: motorcycle theft, vehicle, mobile number, vehicle observation, motorcycle, CCTV, bus stand, night
